scams.name: The Tinder Date Bar Trap
scams.avoidance: Choose your own venue for any date — somewhere you've independently found with good reviews Ask for a price list before anything is served Never sign a bill or authorize payment while intoxicated File a credit card chargeback immediately — you may have recourse

scams.name: The Unofficial Taxi No-Meter Rip-Off
scams.avoidance: Use the official Dubai Taxi app or Careem (local Uber equivalent) Only take taxis from official ranks inside the terminal Uber is also fully operational in Dubai

scams.name: The Gold Souk Fake Weight / Bait-and-Switch
scams.avoidance: Inspect the exact piece you paid for before leaving the store Ask for a certificate of authenticity and official receipt Large, well-established shops in the center of the souk are lower risk than peripheral smaller stalls

scams.name: The Desert Safari Overcharge
scams.avoidance: Book directly with a licensed operator or through your hotel concierge Read recent TripAdvisor reviews — not just star ratings Anything under AED 150 for a full desert safari is almost certainly cutting corners
scams.location: Desert safari operators, tourist booking offices

scams.name: The Timeshare Presentation Lure
scams.avoidance: There are no free tickets — there's always a catch Simply decline and walk away
scams.location: Dubai Mall, JBR Walk, hotel lobbies
